name: std::generate_canonical

declarations.code:
template <class RealType, std::size_t Bits, class Generator>

RealType generate_canonical(Generator &g);

intro:
Generates a random floating point number in range [0, 1).

To generate enough entropy, generate_canonical() will call g() exactly \(\small k\)k times, where \(\small k = \max(1, \lceil \frac{b}{\log_2 R} \rceil)\)k = max(1, ⌈ b / log2 R ⌉) and

b = std::min(Bits, std::size_t {std::numeric_limits<RealType>::digits}),
 R = g.max() - g.min() + 1.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
g

 -

 generator to use to acquire entropy

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: None except from those thrown by g.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Some existing implementations have a bug where they may occasionally return 1.0 if RealType is float  GCC #63176 LLVM #18767 MSVC STL #1074. This is LWG issue 2524.

summary: Generates a random floating point number in range [0, 1).
